revenue_scope: Viatris consolidated Yupelri net sales (Key Product Net Sales, on a Consolidated Basis)
geography: Viatris consolidated (all territories where Viatris books Yupelri; U.S. only before ex-U.S. launches)
why_separate: Viatris's consolidated line differs slightly from Theravance's 'U.S. net sales recognized by Viatris' line from 2022Q4 (56.0 vs 55.700; 2023Q4 60.5 vs 60.644; 2025Q2 66.6 vs 66.330), so it is not joined to the gold series theravance_yupelri, which keeps one issuer and one U.S. scope from 2019Q2.
notes: Printed by Viatris from its first product table as Viatris (Q1 2021 release); Mylan N.V. printed no YUPELRI figure for 2019-2020. 2021 quarters equal Theravance's retrospective chart (36.9, 41.8, 39.4, 43.8). The cause of the post-2022Q3 differences is not stated in either issuer's documents; Theravance began recognizing non-U.S. YUPELRI royalties in Q4 2022, which is consistent with but does not prove an ex-U.S. component.
search_log: Listed Viatris (CIK 0001792044) filings via data.sec.gov; fetched every Item 2.02 8-K exhibit 2021-01 to 2026-10 and every 10-K/10-Q 2020-2023; extracted the Yupelri row from each 'Key Product Net Sales, on a Consolidated Basis' table.
2020 10-K/10-Qs (filed under CIK 1792044 before and after the November 2020 combination) print no Yupelri figure; the FY2020 10-K mentions YUPELRI only in narrative.
